description: Computes US federal income tax (2026 IRS brackets, post-OBBBA) plus an estimated state income tax, with a full progressive bracket breakdown. Example: { grossIncome: 95000, filingStatus: "single", stateCode: "CA" }. Estimate for guidance — 2026 rates from official sources (IRS/Tax Foundation/CRA/ATO/state revenue offices/HMRC).

dependents.description: Number of qualifying children for the Child Tax Credit.

filingStatus.description: IRS filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), hoh (head of household), mfs (married filing separately).

itemizedAmount.description: Total itemized deductions in USD (only used if useItemized is true and it exceeds the standard deduction).

preTaxContributions.description: Annual pre-tax 401(k)/traditional IRA contributions, reduces taxable income.

stateCode.description: Optional two-letter state code to also estimate state income tax. Omit to skip state estimation.

useItemized.description: Use itemized deductions instead of the standard deduction.

name: us_income_tax
title: US federal + state income tax
